title: Learning between civilizations
changes: Consenting trade partners can exchange paid lessons toward four discoveries. Route details show agreed costs, completed lessons and actual research gained.
Development versions start fresh worlds instead of migrating older saves. Current-version worlds still save and resume.

title: Working the shore
changes: Build shore fisheries on owned coastal land. Each operating fishery needs a local resident and Materials to produce Food.
Net frames and fish markers identify installed sites; inspection shows construction, staffing, supplies and actual output.

title: Distinct choices through history
changes: Seeded strategic temperaments give civilizations different development and trade preferences, constrained by Food needs and existing commitments.
Chronicle cards describe civic, government, research and era results plainly, with original event details still available.
